purpose: Test whether a proper explicitly conditional multiscale spatial likelihood with direct sampling fixes the joint high-density and morphology failures left by V24/V25.

single_coherent_change.from: V25 base-48 conditional-affine EDM with a proper unweighted denoising objective and 40-step probability-flow sampling
single_coherent_change.to: an exact coarse-to-fine conditional normalizing-flow likelihood on the same frozen V21 conditional-affine latent, with direct ancestral sampling

inherited_unchanged: TNG100, SIMBA, and Swift train/validation data and the same 16-object development subsets
six frozen V21 conditional-affine caches, V21 profile, G21 transform, and V14 physical inverse
four target-free condition channels: preprocessed count, preprocessed velocity, corrected deterministic mean, and radius
eight train-only source-balanced observable context features
training, validation, and sampling seed lineage
field evaluator and all Q3/Q4/Q5 thresholds

coordinate_system.input_target: frozen V21 exact-zero-DC conditional-affine Gaussianized latent
coordinate_system.coarsest_dc: fixed to zero and excluded from the likelihood
coordinate_system.standardization: 42 train-only equal-source Haar level/channel means and standard deviations
coordinate_system.post_sample_dc_operation: one numerical roundoff-only cube centering before the unchanged V21/V14 inverse; report the pre-centering DC

likelihood.factorization: p(d_coarse|c) times product over finer levels p(d_level|c, reconstructed_coarser_latent)
likelihood.base: independent standard normal for every standardized Haar detail coefficient

conditioner.local_inputs: passive Haar details, four adaptively pooled condition fields, and reconstructed coarser latent
conditioner.global_inputs: eight standardized observable context features broadcast at every scale

likelihood.objective: equal-source mean exact negative log likelihood per non-DC dimension

training_protocol.mixed_precision: CUDA autocast plus GradScaler; spline algebra and log-determinants in float32
training_protocol.augmentation: uniform random one of 48 signed cube isometries applied jointly before Haar analysis

hard_preflight: exact registry and all parent/artifact hashes
all 262143 non-DC dimensions covered exactly once and the sole DC excluded
fixed-batch spline forward/inverse roundtrip and log-determinant cancellation
finite real-data loss and gradients on a 2/2/2 source-balanced batch
direct-sampling RNG reproducibility and pre-centering DC audit

diagnostics_and_selection.selection: smallest candidate passing every unchanged field check plus Q3 and Q4 independently in TNG100, SIMBA, and Swift
new_nonselection_diagnostics: train and fixed validation NLL by source and Haar scale
base-z mean, standard deviation, skewness, and excess kurtosis by Haar scale
spline forward/inverse roundtrip and logdet cancellation

failure_classification_at_step_30000.condition: Q3 and Q4 pass in every domain but any unchanged field check fails
field gates pass but Q3 or Q4 fails in any domain
no all-domain pass and balanced validation NLL improves by less than 0.5 percent from step 25000 to 30000
no all-domain pass without the frozen NLL plateau condition

fixed_decision_order: freeze this registry before candidate training or development evaluation
implement and test the exact registered conditional Haar flow only
commit the implementation and run the Lageunha Ada hard preflight
train once from scratch to 30000 with no interventions
select the smallest all-domain pass or apply the frozen failure classification
do not change spline bins/bounds, masks, capacity, loss, horizon, seeds, sampler, thresholds, or add post-hoc clipping after seeing results

approval_firewall.Astrid_access: forbidden until a three-domain development pass, committed seal, and explicit user approval
